jobs.title: Senior Implementation Consultant - Alternatives
jobs.description:
SS\&C is a leading provider of mission\-critical, AI\-powered technology and services empowering financial services and healthcare organizations to work smarter, faster, and securely. Founded in 1986, SS\&C is headquartered in Windsor, Connecticut, and has offices worldwide. More than 23,000 financial services and healthcare organizations, from the world's largest companies to small and mid\-market firms, rely on SS\&C for expertise, scale, and technology.  



  

**Job Description**

  

**Senior Implementation Consultant \- Alternatives**

  

**Locations** : NY, NY \| Hybrid  



  

**Get To Know Us:**

SS\&C provides premier global investment technology to support the front, middle and back\-office designed to optimize operational and investment alpha throughout the entire investment process. Our employees are at the heart of our success. At SS\&C, we foster career growth at all levels within the company and encourage employees to take ownership of their careers. As a result, many of our leaders have risen to their current roles, as we vigorously advocate upward and lateral mobility. We recruit the best and the brightest for our team by seeking talented, hard\-working individuals who are enthusiastic about learning and realizing their potential.  



  

**Overview:**  

SS\&C is looking for a Senior Implementation Consultant to join the Alternatives (Alts) Implementations team responsible for onboarding the Eze OMS. We are looking for an organized individual that can coordinate with a variety of internal/external stakeholders, communicate with project managers, and consult on solutions to best fit clients’ business use cases. If you enjoy working with financial technology and being a knowledgeable product expert in a collaborative team\-based environment, we want to hear from you!
  

  

Implementation Consultants play an essential role in nearly every phase of SS\&C’s implementation project, from post\-sales project design to client requirement delivery. Collaboration is an important part of the role, to ensure that the onboarding requirements are understood by internal/external stakeholders and implemented to plan, ultimately driving client satisfaction through effective project execution. In addition, Implementation Consultants are responsible for creating effective, scalable, and supportable configurations through testing and analysis of different workflows based off initial requirement gathering. We expect the individual to help develop and apply best practices with an eye on constantly improving the team’s effectiveness.  



  

**Why You Will Love It Here!**

* **Flexibility** : Hybrid Work Model and Business Casual Dress Code, including jeans
* **Your Future:** 401k Matching Program, Professional Development Reimbursement
* **Work/Life Balance:** Flexible Personal/Vacation Time Off, Sick Leave, Paid Holidays
* **Your Wellbeing:** Medical, Dental, Vision, Employee Assistance Program, Parental Leave
* **Wide Ranging Perspectives:** Committed to Celebrating the Variety of Backgrounds, Talents and Experiences of Our Employees
* **Training:** Hands\-On, Team\-Customized, including SS\&C University
* **Extra Perks:** Discounts on fitness clubs, travel and more!

  

**What You Will Get To Do:**

* Partner with Sales and Implementation Architects to understand client workflows and define Order Management requirements
* Own the configuration and testing of front\-office solutions, with a focus on core Order Management, Trading and related integrations
* Manage functional delivery across multiple concurrent client implementations
* Collaborate with team members across all aspects of implementations, from documenting business requirements to defining system configurations and integration requirements, while providing backup coverage as needed
* Configure client workflows based on approved functional requirements and implementation best practices
* Coordinate user acceptance testing, track readiness, and resolve issues affecting delivery
* Lead OMS training for Portfolio Managers, Traders, Operations teams, and other user groups
* Coordinate with clients, third parties, Project Managers, and specialist teams, including FIX, API, and Compliance
* Communicate functional status, risks, dependencies, and required decisions to relevant stakeholders
* Support onsite and remote go\-live events, triage post\-launch issues, and prepare clients for transition to ongoing support
* Document client configurations, workflows, and customizations to support effective knowledge transfer
* Use AI and automation tools responsibly to reduce manual effort, improve implementation workflows, and accelerate delivery
Build alternatives industry expertise through engagement with hedge funds, asset managers, and ETF providers  
* 

  

**What You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 5\+ years of professional experience in either a financial services or technology onboarding role preferred
* Demonstrated project management and organizational skills; must have the ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects effectively in a fast\-paced environment
* Must have analytical thinking and problem\-solving abilities
* Effective communication skills to set internal and external expectations
* Usage of AI tools for process automation and productivity enhancement
Working knowledge of relational databases, Windows server environments and experience learning new technical tools.  
* 

  

Thank you for your interest in SS\&C! If applicable, to further explore this opportunity, please apply directly with us through our Careers page on our corporate website: www.ssctech.com/careers .  



  

\#LI\-MB3


\#CA\-MB  



Unless explicitly requested or approached by SS\&C Technologies, Inc. or any of its affiliated companies, the company will not accept unsolicited resumes from headhunters, recruitment agencies, or fee\-based recruitment services.  



SS\&C Technologies offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your wellbeing, growth, and future. Our benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage; a 401(k) plan with company match; paid time off, holidays, and parental leave; and professional development reimbursement opportunity.  

Actual base salary will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to relevant skills, prior experience, education, demonstrated performance, and geographic location.
New York: The expected base salary for the position is between 120000 USD to 160000 USD.  

In addition, employees in this role may be eligible for consideration on an annual basis for a discretionary bonus and/or equity awards, such as restricted stock units or stock options, based upon individual and business performance at the company’s discretion.### 

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Clinical Implementation Specialist
jobs.description:
**Clinical Implementation Specialist**

Account Engagement – I/O Urology Diagnostics Inc (CarePath)

**About I/O Urology**

I/O Urology is dedicated to enhancing the lives of those living with urologic conditions by providing a convenient, accessible, and stress\-free way to monitor their health from the comfort of home. Through our CarePath device, patients gather accurate, reliable data without frequent clinic visits, giving patients and providers immediate access to insights that enhance diagnosis, treatment, and ongoing care.

**Position Summary**

The Clinical Implementation Specialist is the hands\-on partner for clinics adopting the CarePath System. This role ensures that CarePath becomes fully embedded in the clinic’s Lower Urinary Tract Symptom (LUTS) care pathway — that ordering a CarePath Evaluation becomes a routine, reliable step in how the practice works up and manages LUTS patients, and that the resulting reports are consistently retrieved, reviewed, and acted on.

You will work closely with physicians, Advanced Practice Providers (APPs), and clinic operations teams to design, implement, and optimize CarePath workflows — from ordering and receiving CarePath Evaluations to provider review and action planning. This role bridges the clinical and operational sides of healthcare delivery, helping practices efficiently adopt CarePath, improve patient engagement, and deliver better care outcomes through better use of data. Internally, you will collaborate with I/O Urology’s IT, Patient Support, Sales, and Marketing teams to create clarity in the delivery of information through the CarePath Evaluation.

New account onboarding is the center of gravity for this role. Once Sales has established the value of CarePath with the initial ordering providers at an account, you own the transition from interest to routine use CarePath is designed to be simple to implement ; success in this role comes from knowing how a urology clinic operates and being the person every clinic stakeholder—is comfortable working with.

**Key Responsibilities**

**New Account Onboarding**

* Own the handoff from Sales at newly signed accounts and drive the account from initial provider interest to routine, self\-sufficient use of CarePath.
* Onboard the account Administrator to establish and configure I/O Urology portal access
* Train ordering staff to place complete CarePath orders and to retrieve and route CarePath Evaluation reports from the portal.
* Work with the practice and its IT resources to build CarePath into the way orders are already placed in the EMR, including order sets, so that ordering CarePath requires no new habit. Understand how the clinic utilizes its systems to share workflow information between providers and staff.
* Confirm that each new account can independently complete the full cycle — order placed, patient supported, report retrieved, report reviewed — before considering onboarding complete.
* Establish a named point of contact at the account and a clear escalation path back into I/O Urology.

**Clinical Adoption \& Workflow Integration**

* Partner with clinics to integrate CarePath seamlessly into their LUTS care pathways.
* Ensure smooth execution of CarePath processes: ordering, receiving, reviewing, and applying evaluation report insights.
* Coordinate with clinic scheduling staff so that patient appointments align with CarePath evaluation timelines and reports are available when the patient is next seen.
* Train staff on what constitutes a complete and valid order from the treating provider, so that evaluations can be performed without avoidable rework or delay.
* Identify and resolve friction in the CarePath workflow — incomplete orders, reports not reaching the ordering provider, portal access gaps — and re\-train as needed.
* Understand the key players within a clinic’s team – those who often drive activity beyond their title – and leverage their help for CarePath integration into the LUTS care pathways.

**Provider Engagement \& Report Education**

* Be comfortable and credible in front of providers: able to walk a physician or APP through a CarePath Evaluation report and the insights the data reveals about their patient.
* Educate providers on interpreting CarePath data and translating it into their own clinical decision\-making. This education is one of the primary drivers of provider confidence in CarePath and of sustained use
* Bring recurring provider questions, points of confusion, and report\-interpretation themes back to the CMO, Marketing, and Product Development so materials, reports, and product can be improved.
* Coordinate closely with Sales, who own the commercial relationship and the case for CarePath. Your role is to make CarePath easy to use and easy to understand — not to sell it.

**Stakeholder Engagement**

* Build trust\-based relationships across the clinic
* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for CarePath implementation questions at assigned accounts.
* Communicate clearly and adapt to the audience — the same workflow explanation lands differently with a physician, an office manager, and an IT administrator.

**Training \& Ongoing Support**

* Deliver training virtually, using portal walkthroughs and short, role\-specific sessions that fit into a clinic’s day.
* Maintain and improve role\-based training materials and quick\-reference guides for Administrators, ordering staff, and providers.
* Re\-train accounts after staff turnover, as requested, and proactively check in with accounts whose usage patterns suggest a workflow or access problem.
* Support onsite when an account genuinely requires it.

**Internal Collaboration**

* Partner with I/O Urology’s IT team on portal access, integration, and troubleshooting.
* Coordinate as necessary with Patient Support Services to ensure congruity between account and patient engagement.
* Provide Sales with a clear picture of implementation status and readiness at each account.
* Work with Marketing to create adoption tools, communication resources, and educational materials.

**Implementation Quality \& Continuous Improvement**

* Track the operational health of assigned accounts — order completeness, portal proficiency, report retrieval, and time from order to report review — and act on what the data shows.
* Identify and remove barriers within the CarePath workflow itself; escalate recurring or systemic issues internally rather than working around them account by account.
* Contribute to standardizing the implementation playbook so that onboarding is consistent and repeatable across accounts and specialists.
* Document implementation activity and account status accurately and in accordance with I/O Urology policy.

**Qualifications**

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in nursing, healthcare administration, or a related field preferred; equivalent clinical or clinic\-operations experience considered.
* 3–5\+ years of experience in clinic workflow, clinical implementation, care coordination, practice operations, or
* Strongly preferred: direct experience in a urology clinic, or in another specialty clinic with comparable diagnostic ordering workflows. Experience with multiple EMRs
* Working knowledge of how orders are placed in an EMR, including order sets, and of who does what in a clinic between order and result.
* Comfort demonstrating and teaching a web\-based portal to non\-technical users.
* Experience interacting directly with physicians and APPs in a clinical or implementation capacity.
* Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and handling of protected health information.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* **Clinic Workflow Fluency –** Skilled at navigating the real workflow of a busy clinic and identifying where a new step will and will not stick.
* **Interpersonal Range –** Builds rapport quickly and credibly across the full range of clinic stakeholders, from physician to medical assistant to IT.
* **Provider Credibility –** Confident and comfortable speaking with physicians and APPs about clinical data; able to share insight from a CarePath Evaluation without overstepping into clinical decision\-making.
* **Teaching Clarity –** Able to explain a workflow or portal function clearly to someone with limited available time and little interest in software.
* **Organization \& Follow\-Through –** Runs multiple account onboardings in parallel and follows each through to genuine self\-sufficiency.
* **Problem Solving –** Resourceful in diagnosing why a workflow isn’t working — access, training, timing, or ownership — and fixing the actual cause.
* **Remote Effectiveness –** Effective virtually: builds trust and delivers training over video and phone
* **Compliance Judgment –** Understands the boundary between supporting the correct use of a diagnostic service and supporting a practice’s business — and stays on the right side of it.

**Scope \& Compliance Boundaries**

I/O Urology Diagnostics is an Independent Diagnostic Testing Facility (IDTF). The Clinical Implementation Specialist supports the correct ordering, performance, and delivery of the CarePath Evaluation — and nothing beyond it. Specifically, this role:

* Supports workflow only as it relates to CarePath ordering, patient participation, and report retrieval and review; it does not provide general practice management, staffing, throughput, coding, billing, revenue, or marketing consulting to accounts.
* Does not solicit, initiate, modify, or influence the content of a treating provider’s order, and does not order tests on a provider’s behalf.
* Educates providers on the clinical content of CarePath Evaluation reports; it does not make or direct clinical decisions, and does not document in the practice’s medical record or perform the practice’s clinical or administrative work.
* Does not directly solicit patients, and does not offer anything of independent value to an account or its staff as an inducement to order.

All activity is conducted in accordance with I/O Urology’s compliance program, the federal Anti\-Kickback Statute, and applicable IDTF performance standards.

**Work Environment**

This is a predominantly virtual role. CarePath is designed to be straightforward to implement and explain, and most accounts can be fully onboarded and supported remotely. Expect up to 20% travel for accounts where onsite presence is genuinely warranted, along with occasional flexibility outside standard business hours to reach clinic staff and providers when their schedules allow.

**Performance Metrics**

* Time from account signature to first CarePath order placed, and to a fully onboarded account
* Onboarding completeness — Administrator trained, portal access configured, ordering staff trained, report retrieval verified
* Order completeness and accuracy at assigned accounts (rate of orders requiring rework)
* Time from report availability to provider review
* Account self\-sufficiency — reduction in basic access and how\-to support requests after onboarding
* Provider and staff feedback on training quality and responsiveness
* Quality and timeliness of implementation documentation and internal handoffs

**Why Join I/O Urology?**

* Be part of a company redefining the standard of urologic care.
* Help clinics harness the power of better data for better patient outcomes.
* Collaborate with a mission\-driven, passionate team.

**Compensation \& Benefits**

* Competitive salary. Paid time off.
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision coverage.
* 401(k) with company match.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development.

Pay: $74,000\.00 \- $104,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: HCAI - HEALTH INFORMATION AND ELECTRONIC RECORDS ANALYST TRAINING PROGRAM
jobs.description:
Description: **\*\*\*Eligible Applicants must be residents of California. \*\*\*****Next Cohorts Begin: 11/17/2026**  

**\*\*PLEASE NOTE: "This is a grant\-funded training program, not an employment opportunity" Employment is not guaranteed at the completion of the program\*\***  

**Selection for participation in the training program is NOT guaranteed.** **Applying** **or** **being referred** **to apply does NOT guarantee acceptance, as participation is subject to HCAI enrollment guidelines.****Description:**


The Health Information and EHR Systems Analyst program (HIER) is designed to equip students with the skills and knowledge needed to manage healthcare information and electronic health record (EHR) systems effectively. This program provides hands\-on training in EPIC, SQL, Tableau, and Crystal Reports, preparing students for real\-world challenges in clinical data management, system implementation, and reporting. Participants will also gain foundational knowledge to support healthcare IT systems, ensuring data accuracy, security, and compliance.

***This program prepares students for the HIMSS CAHIMS certification, providing a strong pathway into health information technology and EHR specialist roles across healthcare settings.***

**Note: This program consists of 3 Phases:**

**1\. Online classroom training (approximately 18 weeks)**

**2\. Online Internship (approximately 11 weeks)**

**3\. Externship\- in person/onsite for hand\-on training (approximately 10 weeks)**

**Participation in all components above is required and require a commitment of 40 hours per week during standard business hours. The entire program as a whole is approximately 39\-44 weeks in duration.**

**Eligibility Requirements:**

* **Applicants must be residents of California and live within 30–45 minutes of San** **Jose, CA.**
* Must be 18 years or older
* Must have a high school diploma or GED certification
* Must be a U.S. Citizen/National or have a valid Lawful Permanent Resident Alien (not open to non\-citizens or Visa holders)
* Must have proficient computer experience (MS Windows \& MS Suite (Word, Excel, PP, Outlook)
* Ability to type Net 40 wpm
* **Great attention to detail and strict HIPAA compliance**
* **Analytical and detail oriented.**
* **Able to learn in a self\-directed, fast\-paced, rapidly changing environment.**

**Program Details:**

* ***Schedule:*** The training program runs Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and includes a living stipend.
* ***Commitment:*** The program includes remote learning and remote hands\-on internship/externship training. Accepted participants must complete 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, during regular business hours for the entire duration of the program.
* ***Compensation*****:** $31,200, This stipend is distributed over approximately 44 weeks for participation in both remote learning and remote hands\-on internship/ externship training. Stipend payment is made on OCHIN’s semi\-monthly pay schedule.
* ***Benefits:*** Eligible for monthly benefits reimbursement of up to $600 (participant cost only). Some restrictions apply. Also, Internet Stipend $35/month for 44 weeks
* ***Attendance Policy:***Participants are not eligible to receive paid holidays or paid time off (PTO), all missed time will need to be made up.

**Program Objectives:**

* Learn to apply specialized health care and database management insights to analyze important clinical data, identify trends, and create targeted reports.
* Develop expertise in managing health information and EHR systems to support healthcare organizations.
* Apply data management skills using tools such as EPIC, SQL, Tableau, and Crystal Reports to analyze and report clinical data.
* Understand and implement system design, testing, and security protocols to ensure data privacy and compliance.
* Prepare for the HIMSS CAHIMS certification exam, focusing on healthcare IT, leadership, and system analysis.
* Support healthcare teams in optimizing operational workflows and improving patient outcomes through technology


Requirements:
* Work newly identified duplicate/overlay cases using designated reports, work queues, e\-mail communications and phone calls.
* Conduct detailed review of identified issues and documentation in logs and data bases.
* Follows established procedure for combining cases, moving cases, adding known non\-duplicates.
* Professional communication with downstream and external users.
* Review and process information collected from various inbound interfaces and Epic sub systems to ensure data integrity
* Prepare reports for distribution and monitors for completion.
* Provide support to healthcare staff for EPIC and other EHR systems by troubleshooting and resolving application issues.
* Manage data integrity through error queue management and accurate reporting, including lab, prescription, and charge routing errors.
* Collaborate with clinical teams to enhance system efficiency and improve health information processes.
* Maintain user accounts, workstations, and system configurations to ensure smooth operations.
* Lead system testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance, ensuring compliance with privacy and security standard
* Oversight of the quality, timeliness, and accuracy of the medical record and patient indexes for patient care, legal, revenue, research, and regulatory needs
* Maintaining the security and integrity of health information
* Collection, quality control, and dissemination of data for comparative databases and statistical reports including specific disease and procedure registries
* Maintains and contributes to patient care by organizing and maintaining patients’ medical records and health information
* Answers requests for information and documents
* Updates and reviews medical records by reviewing information, notifying healthcare providers of record deficiencies, and tracking outstanding records
* Maintains patient confidence and protects our operations by keeping information confidential and complying with privacy policies and regulation
* Updates medical history in a timely manner
* Receiving and processing patient forms, medical histories, and test results
* Analyzing the information collected to ensure that it is correct and accurate
* Assessing health records and insurance claims
* Ensuring compliance with confidentiality laws and regulations
* Managing and updating data for clinical databases and registries
* Other duties as assigned.

**OCHIN Workforce Development Equal Opportunity Statement**

We are dedicated to a policy of non\-discrimination for all members of the OCHIN community, including learners, team members, and applicants. jobs.description:
**Department Information**
--------------------------

  

  

**This position is open to current Colorado residents only.**
Please note: This recruitment may be used to fill multiple vacancies.  

  

  

**Business Innovation, Technology and Security (BITS)**  

  

Operations \& Strategy provides management and oversight for key administrative and technical services that enables CDHS to achieve their goals. It is responsible for a number of support functions to make our agency as efficient, effective and impactful as possible. Operations \& Strategy comprises Human Resources; Facilities Management; Audit; Business Innovation; Technology and Security; Emergency Management; Legal; Performance Management; Communications; Project Management; and Leadership \& Organizational Development.  

  

Business Innovation, Technology, and Security (BITS) is responsible for managing the Department’s information technology (IT) providers, including relations with the Governor’s Office of Information Technology (OIT). The division serves as the main point of contact for departmental issues involving technology resources and needs and coordinates activities with the program staff for IT support, operations, maintenance, modernization and implementation of new IT systems.
**Description of Job**
----------------------


**Hybrid Work Assignment: Minimum of 2 days per week in the office**


Please note: These working arrangements are subject to change


The position provides critical conceptual information\-management, technical and analytical support through the maintenance, design and enhancement of various patient and management data systems.


The position represents the Health Information Technology Team (HIT) as a lead subject matter expert and participates in user groups in order to gather and develop system specifications for modifications to BEHR for the Outpatient Clinic implementation.


Additionally, the position:


* Develops, maintains, and enhances critical budget\-management systems, clinical information management systems, ancillary analytical and audit systems, and BEHR development, specifically focused on the Outpatient Program.
* Develops legal status, data quality and ad\-hoc management/analysis as needed.
* Completes system upgrades and provides system maintenance.
* Performs system analysis and design of reports, inquiries, and input screens as provided by the tools associated with BEHR and other software reporting applications; explores the use of new BEHR functionality for use by Outpatient Clinic staff; and, develops and executes routine and ad hoc reporting mechanisms necessary to meet business needs and requirements.
**Minimum Qualifications, Substitutions, Conditions of Employment \& Appeal Rights**
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


**EXPERIENCE ONLY:**
  

**Seven (7\) years** total of relevant experience in an occupation related to the work assigned to this position, including a minimum of **three** **(3\) years**of working hands\-on directly with major EHR platforms/systems in their back end, medical records workflow or clinical informatics, and,


OR


**EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**
  

A combination of related education and/or relevant experience in an occupation related to the work assigned to this position equal to **seven** **(7\) years** including, a minimum of **three** **(3\) years** of working hands\-on directly with major EHR platforms/systems in their back end, medical records workflow or clinical informatics.  

  

  

**Preferred** **Qualifications:**
* Demonstrated knowledge of HIPAA, HITECH, Release of Information (ROI) guidelines, and state/federal health data privacy regulations
* Understanding of clinical documentation improvement (CDI), revenue cycle management (RCM), and data governance.
* Understanding of outpatient workflows
* Back end experience with a top 4 industry leader in Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems

  

**Conditions of Employment:**
* Standard background check and reference check required
* This position requires State of Colorado residency at the time of application (unless otherwise identified in the posting), and residency within the state throughout the duration of employment in this position.
* Travel in\-state will be required
* *Former State employees who were disciplinarily terminated or resigned in lieu of termination must:*
	+ *Disclose that information on the application.*
	+ *Explain why the prior termination or resignation should not disqualify you from the current position.*
	+ *Provide your employee number from your prior State employment. Absent extraordinary circumstances, prior disciplinary termination or resignation in lieu of termination and failure to provide this information will disqualify the applicant from future State employment with CDHS.*

  

**CDHS Selection Process Explanation**
Employment history is calculated on a full\-time basis (40/hrs per week). Part\-time employment is calculated on a prorated basis to determine qualifications. Be sure your application specifically addresses your qualifications, experience, work products, and accomplishments as they relate to the position and minimum requirements.
* Preferred Qualifications \& Competencies:
	+ Relevant years of state service experience

  

**Minimum Qualification Screening Process**
A Human Resources Analyst will review the work experience/job duties sections of the online job application to determine whether your experience meets the minimum qualifications for the position. You must complete the official State of Colorado online application. Cover letters and resumes WILL NOT be reviewed during the minimum qualifications screening process. **You must specifically document your work experience and qualifications in the application form. Do not use "see resume" or "see attached."**

  

  

You must meet the minimum qualifications to continue in the selection process. Part\-time work experience will be prorated.  

  

**Comparative Analysis Process – Structured Application Review**
After minimum qualification screening, the comparative analysis process will involve a reviewing and rating of all the information you submit. The comparative analysis step may also include your results from standardized testing.

  

  

**Your Work Experience/Job Duties**
Document your work experience/job duties to the extent to which you possess the skills, education, experience, minimum qualifications, and preferred qualifications.
If listed, answer all supplemental questions as your answers to these questions will be evaluated during this phase. Provide at least 4\-8 sentences for each supplemental question.

  

**Supplemental Questions**
Answer the supplemental questions completely and thoughtfully. We will rate your answers based on the content of your response and your writing skills (spelling, grammar, and clarity of your writing).

  

  

**Appeal Rights**
You may file an appeal with the State Personnel Board or request a review by the State Personnel Director if your application is eliminated. You will find the appeals process, the official appeal form, and how to deliver it on the State Personnel Board website.
* You or your representative must sign and submit the official appeal form for review.
* You can find the official appeal form here.
* You must be deliver the official appeal form to the State Personnel Board:
	+ By email (dpa\_state.personnelboard@state.co.us), or
	+ Postmarked in US Mail to(1525 Sherman Street, 4th Floor, Denver CO 80203, or
	+ Hand delivered (1525 Sherman Street, 4th Floor, Denver CO 80203\), or
	+ Faxed (303\.866\.5038\) within ten (10\) calendar days from your receipt of notice or acknowledgement of the department’s action.

Contact the State Personnel Board for assistance:
* At (303\) 866\-3300, or
* Refer to the Colorado Code of Regulations (CCR) 801\-1, State Personnel Board Rules and Personnel Director's Administrative Procedures, Chapter 8, Resolution of Appeals and Disputes, within the Rules webpage.
  

**Supplemental Information**
----------------------------

  

  

  

**HOW TO APPLY TO THE STATE OF COLORADO**  

  

  

**The Assessment Process**  

  

**For additional recruiting questions, please contact Jade Green at** **jade.green@state.co.us**  

  

  

**About Us \& Benefits**
If your goal is to build a career that makes a difference, join the dedicated people of the Colorado Department of Human Services (CDHS). Our professionals strive to design and deliver high quality human and health services that improve the safety, independence, and well\-being of the people of Colorado. Each of us is committed to contributing to a safe and accessible CDHS. In addition to a great location and rewarding and meaningful work, we offer:
* Strong, secure, yet flexible retirement benefits including a PERA Defined Benefit Plan or PERA Defined Contribution Plan plus 401(k) and 457 plans
* Medical and dental health plans
* Employer supplemented Health Savings Account
* Paid life insurance
* Short\- and long\-term disability coverage
* 11 paid holidays per year plus vacation and sick leave
* State of Colorado Employee BenefitHub Resource Center
* Employee Wellness program
* Excellent work\-life programs, such as flexible schedules, training and more
* Remote work arrangements for eligible positions
* + Some positions may qualify for the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program.

  

**Our Values**
* We believe in a people\-first approach: We prioritize the needs, well\-being, and dignity of the individuals, families and communities we serve. We commit to respect, fairness and access in every decision, policy and interaction. We engage client voices and experiences in the development and implementation of the services we provide.
* Balance creates quality of life: We want our team to be resilient through a supportive workplace that values flexibility, health and wellness, and employee engagement.
* We hold ourselves accountable: We take responsibility through our actions, programs, and results for the state of health and human services in Colorado.
* Transparency matters: We are open and honest with employees, our partners, the Coloradans we serve, and the public.
* We are ethical: We abide by what is best for those we serve by doing what is right, not what is easy.
* Collaboration helps us rise together:We work together with all partners, employees, and clients to achieve the best outcomes for Coloradans.

  

**ADA Accommodations**
  

CDHS is committed to a Colorado for ALL qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, our agency will assist individuals who have a disability with any reasonable accommodation requests related to employment.  

  

This includes completing the application process, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, participating in the employee selection process, and/or performing essential job functions where the requested accommodation does not impose an undue hardship. If you have a disability and require reasonable accommodation to ensure you have a positive experience applying or interviewing for this position, please direct your inquiries to cdhs\_ada@state.co.us.  

  

**EEO Statement**
**\*The State of Colorado is an equal opportunity employer\***


We are committed to increasing a “Colorado for ALL" of our staff and providing culturally responsive programs and services. Therefore, we encourage responses from people of all backgrounds and abilities. The State of Colorado believes that a “Colorado for ALL” drives our success, and we encourage candidates from all identities, backgrounds, and abilities to apply. The State of Colorado is an equal opportunity employer committed to building inclusive, innovative work environments with employees who reflect our communities and enthusiastically serve them. Therefore, in all aspects of the employment process, we provide employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, medical condition related to pregnancy, creed, ancestry, national origin, marital status, genetic information, or military status (with preference given to military veterans), or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

  

  

**Additional Support For Your Application**
Toll Free Applicant Technical Support  

  

If you experience technical difficulty with the NEOGOV system (e.g. uploading or attaching documents to your online application) call NEOGOV technical support at 855\-524\-5627 Mon\-Fri between 6 am and 6 pm (Pacific Time). Helpful hints: if you are having difficulty uploading or attaching documents to your application 1\) ensure your documents are PDF or Microsoft Word files and 2\) close the document before you attempt to upload (attach) it.

jobs.title: CMS Implementation Engineer (Drupal & Wagtail) - Contractor
jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Big challenges need bold thinkers.**


If you’re someone who sees problems as opportunities, you’ll thrive here. **RESPEC is 100% employee\-owned**, which means we take ownership of every challenge. Here, your ideas drive real solutions. Since 1969, we’ve tackled complex challenges in energy transition, infrastructure resilience, digital transformation, and sustainability.

**At RESPEC, you’ll work alongside clients to take on critical problems**. Depending on your expertise, you might design infrastructure in remote locations, develop renewable energy solutions for global projects, or apply data\-driven technology to improve mining and water systems.


We bring deep technical knowledge, real\-world experience, and a commitment to work that matters. If you're looking for a place where your contributions have real impact, you’ll fit right in.

**We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third\-party recruiters.**

 **Job Description**  

RESPEC is seeking a CMS Implementation Specialist that will lead the end\-to\-end technical implementation of the new GeoInfo website (https://geoinfo.nmt.edu), working closely with RESPEC’s project, product management, and design teams, an embedded Content Strategist, the agency’s Product Manager, and the agency’s Data Services and Security staff. This role transforms approved digital strategy, sitemaps, front\-end templates, and structured content models into a robust, high\-performance CMS implementation (leveraging Drupal and/or Wagtail) that meets the Q2 2027 launch milestone for L0–L1 and priority L2 content.


The CMS Implementation Specialist will configure CMS core structures, modules/packages, and publishing workflows; build out approved reusable templates and page models; execute automated and assisted migration of priority text, relational data, and static digital assets; and establish comprehensive redirect and navigational pathways between the legacy system and the new platform. This role also owns technical testing, defect resolution, launch readiness, and external systems integration.

**Responsibilities:**

* Implement approved, responsive CMS page models and structured content types using Drupal (Twig, custom modules, blocks) and Wagtail (StreamField, Page models, Django templates).
* Support the full structural build\-out and taxonomy alignment of the website information architecture from Level 0 through Level 2 and beyond.
* Coordinate with the agency’s technical, infrastructure, and security stakeholders to ensure all architecture decisions align with institutional compliance, accessibility, hosting, and security standards.
* Support the execution of priority content migration workflows in close alignment with the finalized Content Migration Plan.
* Lead the technical extraction, cleaning, and ingestion of legacy static assets—including technical PDF reports, scientific images, and downloadable datasets—into structured CMS media libraries.
* Implement robust URL routing, 301 redirect mappings, menu navigation, breadcrumbs, and cross\-site transition pathways connecting legacy GeoInfo content to the new web environment.
* Lead and support technical testing, including template rendering, responsive UI, editorial workflows, access control permissions, search indexing, and launch\-critical functionality.
* Support the technical integration of third\-party institutional systems, APIs, and enterprise databases (e.g., HigherEd ERP / Ellucian Banner).
* Actively track, estimate, and document implementation deliverables, backlog stories, bugs, and future\-phase technical debt using Jira.
* Deliver a fully tested, secure, and production\-ready live website populated with validated, migrated Level 0 through Level 2 content by target deadlines.

**Time Required**


This is anticipated as a full\-time contract role for the implementation\-heavy phase of the project lifecycle. The role becomes most intensive once hosting, CMS selection/architecture, sitemaps, and design templates are signed off, remaining fully engaged through core development, migration, system integration, testing, and production deployment.

 **Qualifications** **Requirements:**

* 3–5\+ years of demonstrable hands\-on CMS development and technical implementation experience, with a track record of delivering multiple production website builds, custom module/model configurations, and large\-scale data migrations.
* Hands\-on development and implementation experience with modern enterprise CMS platforms, with direct proficiency in Drupal (PHP, Composer, Twig) and/or Wagtail (Python, Django).
* Deep technical understanding of modular structured content, reusable templates, atomic page components, custom field configurations, and multi\-tier editorial publishing workflows.
* Demonstrated experience executing content migration pipelines, database transformation scripts, and digital asset migrations for extensive static repositories (PDFs, media files, datasets).
* Working knowledge of end\-to\-end web QA, functional and cross\-browser testing, accessibility compliance (WCAG), redirect rule engines, and go\-live deployment procedures.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate smoothly across multi\-disciplinary teams including software engineers, UI/UX designers, content strategists, project managers, and executive client stakeholders.
* Proven experience managing implementation sprints, tickets, pull requests, and bug backlogs using Jira or comparable agile project management tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with an emphasis on creating clear technical documentation, architectural decision records (ADRs), and handoff guides.

**Preferred:**

* New Mexico and West Texas residents willing to travel on\-site to Socorro, NM, up to 2 times during the project lifecycle.
* Direct experience engineering web solutions for Higher Education, scientific research organizations, geological surveys, or public\-sector agencies.

  

**Additional Information**  

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
